tree_path_why: Resp rate 24 ≤ 27 + ST elevation (mV) 0.286 > 0.0985 → Acute Coronary Ischemia

dont_give_list.spoken: Do not give nitroglycerin. Blood pressure is too low.

protocol_steps.title: Patient Posture & High-Flow Oxygen
protocol_steps.action: Place astronaut in semi-sitting position (45°). Administer high-flow 100% O2.

protocol_steps.title: ⛔ NITROGLYCERIN CONTRAINDICATED (BP < 90)
protocol_steps.action: DO NOT GIVE NITROGLYCERIN! Administer chewable Aspirin (325 mg) ONLY. Monitor BP closely.
protocol_steps.warning: ⛔ HARD-BLOCK: DO NOT ADMINISTER NITROGLYCERIN! Systolic BP is critically low (82 mmHg < 90 mmHg). High risk of fatal cardiogenic collapse!

protocol_steps.title: Automated External Defibrillator (AED)
protocol_steps.action: Retrieve AED from Bay B2. Attach pads in antero-apical configuration. Stand by for rhythm analysis.
